name: Lateral Shuffle
steps: Set up in a low athletic stance with feet wider than shoulder width, hips pushed back, knees bent, and chest lifted.
Push forcefully off your trailing foot to glide sideways while stepping your lead foot out smoothly.
Draw your trailing foot quickly back to hip width without letting your feet click together or cross over.
Shuffle continuously across your space, alternating directions smoothly so both legs take turns leading for the target duration.
tips: Stay low at one steady hip height throughout the shuffle instead of bouncing up and down.
Keep your toes pointing forward and knees aligned cleanly over your feet on every push-off.
